training.feature_source: causal pre-action observations only; no phase/outcome labels in input whitelist

training.weak_control_notice: Full frame-wise label shuffle; weak temporal negative control, not whole-trajectory shuffle.

limitations: Synthetic state/action demonstrations from an authored PiPER controller, not human video or teleoperation.
Learned inference uses privileged simulator joint, TCP, object and contact measurements; no vision pipeline is trained.
Only starting-position interpolation for a 40 g rigid block and two trained destinations is evaluated.
The pinned native servo and rate limiter remain authored low-level control; no teacher, phase machine or IK is called by the student.
Uncalibrated simulated friction, contacts and actuators; no physical robot qualification or other-arm transfer.
Compute latency excludes sensing, camera processing, communication and physical actuation; CPU/GPU minima are not certified.

Simulation-only time-conditioned trajectory distillation from synthetic authored-controller demonstrations. Initial privileged object XY, two known goals and measured clock condition learned feed-forward references; native servos remain authored. No learned contact feedback, recovery, camera learning or physical robot qualification.
